CLUTCH – CLUTCH RELEASE CYLINDER (2JZ–GTE)

CLUTCH RELEASE CYLINDER
(2JZ–GTE)
COMPONENTS

Release Cylinder
Spring
Piston
Boot
Push Rod
Clutch Housing Cover LH

Y 005259

SST

004187

RELEASE CYLINDER REMOVAL

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
INSTALLATION HINT: After installation, adjust the clutch pedal and bleed the clutch system.

1. REMOVE CLUTCH HOUSING COVER LH
Remove the 2 bolts.
Torque: 12 N·m (120 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)

2. DISCONNECT CLUTCH LINE
Using SST, disconnect the clutch line union. Use a container to catch the fluid.
SST 09023–00100
Torque: 15 N·m (155 kgf·cm, 11 ft·lbf)

3. REMOVE 2 BOLTS AND PULL OUT RELEASE CYLINDER
Torque: 12 N·m (120 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)
